steps.title: Receive inbound
steps.narration: Someone just filled out your 'Request a Demo' form. Lermontov pulls the form data, enriches it against your CRM, and scores the lead against your ICP — all before the autoresponder fires.

steps.title: Qualify the lead
steps.narration: Lermontov qualifies Raj: 87/100 ICP match. Nova is in your top-20 account list. He's Head of Growth with budget authority. The trigger says 'evaluating tools for Q3' — urgency: medium-high.

data.subject: Raj Patel — Nova Supply Chain — demo requested (87/100 ICP)
data.body:
New inbound demo request:

Raj Patel, Head of Growth @ Nova Supply Chain
Series B, $38M · Top-20 account · 87/100 ICP match

Context: Nova just raised their B in March. Hiring 3 sellers in Q3. Raj's LinkedIn mentions 'evaluating pipeline tools' — your window is now.

Recommended action: Book within 24h. Suggested AE: Mira. Suggested deck: Q3 growth pitch + Anders case study.

― Lermontov (via Mira Rao, operator)

steps.title: Book the meeting
steps.narration: Lermontov drafts the reply, checks Mira's calendar, and proposes 3 slots. The reply lands in Raj's inbox within 5 minutes of his form submission. Total conversations this month: 1.2k.
